lines.en: I walk step by step, slowly.
My long coat drags on the snow.
My head is low; my breath fogs.
My hooves press the snow firm.
A herd follows behind me.
I push the snow aside for grass.
I break the snow step by step.
I walk down the slope.
My shoulder brushes a herdmate.
I stop and stand.
I turn slowly, hooves in the snow.
I paw the snow aside.
Ice hangs from my coat.
I walk at the front of the line.
My breath frosts on my coat.
I stand against the wind.
Frost has set in my coat.

lines.zh: 我把鼻子埋进雪里找草。
lines.en: I push my nose into the snow for grass.
I look for grass roots in the snow.
I stay still, heavy.
My horns point outward.
I stand to shield my herdmates.
I listen to the wind from the north.

lines.zh: 我呼出的气在毛上结冰。
lines.en: My breath freezes on my coat.
I shift a hoof.
I look at the far snow slope.
I nudge the snow with a horn.
There is frost on my back.
I tuck one leg under me.
I chew the roots beneath the snow.
You're too close to my herd.
My qiviut blocks the wind.
My herd is here.
Get clear of the herd.
I dislike being driven.
I turn my horns at you.
You look light.
I stand between us.

lines.zh: 我从鼻孔里哼出一股白气。
lines.en: I huff a plume of white breath.
My hind hoof sinks and I give ground.
My coat is cut.

lines.zh: 这一下我记住了你的力道。
lines.en: I remember the weight of that blow.

lines.zh: 我把四只蹄子分开踩实。
lines.en: I spread my four hooves and plant them.
I lower my head, horns forward.
Coat torn; I can still butt.
I drop my shoulder to the snow.
I watch you from behind my shaggy coat.
I paw the snow.
I lower my head, horns forward.
Grass. Not stone.
Is that grass in your hand?
Set the grass on the snow.
I walk over through the snow.
Not enough for a herd.
Do you have much?

lines.zh: 我低头闻了闻雪里的草。
lines.en: I lower my head to smell grass in the snow.
Step back; I'm lowering my head.
Too dry to chew well.
I chew slowly; my coat thickens.

lines.zh: 你撞上我的厚毛，退开了。
lines.en: You hit my thick coat and fall back.
I didn't shift a hoof.
My coat is thick; I don't mind a bump.
You stepped on the ice by my hoof.
I turn side-on to let you pass.
Don't crowd into the middle of my herd.
Two thick coats meet with a thud.
My horn grazed you.
I press my hooves into the snow.
Move away; I'm turning.
My herd is already set.
No two-legged ones in this herd.
I stand at the herd's front, blocking wind.
I turn my horns to the wind.
Only we are out in the snow.
Keep off the herd's edge.
Standing in the wind will do.
There are other herds out here.
I close my eyes; frost forms on the lashes.
I lower my head and take the grass.
This isn't grass.
I sniff the snow on it.
Not a mouthful to chew.

lines.zh: 我用鼻子把它拱进雪里。
lines.en: I nose it into the snow.

lines.zh: 雪上掉的东西我都闻一遍。
lines.en: I sniff everything dropped on the snow.

lines.zh: 我用角把它拱到雪堆边。
lines.en: I hook it aside into the snowbank.

lines.zh: 我的绒毛可不随便给人。
lines.en: My qiviut isn't given freely.
You broke up our herd.
My horns face forward.
I plant my hooves.

lines.zh: 我把壮实的身子转过来。
lines.en: I swing my heavy body around.
You've backed to the slope.
No hurry. I carry a lot of weight.
At three I lower my head.
Head down, horns aimed at you.
My horns are forward.
Body sideways, blocking the snow wind.
I pack the snow step by step.
You back away into deep snow.
I drive you toward the herd.
Do you hear the low snorting?
I bring my horns to your chest.
One more step and you're at the slope edge.
I turn side-on across your path.
The snow packs hard under me.
I stand firm in the snow.
I butt you with my horns.
That butt used my whole shoulder.
I stamp.
You're knocked into the snow.

lines.zh: 雪里顶一下，毛都立起来。
lines.en: One shove in the snow and my coat bristles.
My shoulder pins you.
You fall back two steps into deep snow.
I back into the herd.
I lower my horns.
I come from behind the snow slope.
The grass here is under snow.
My coat is all frost.
I shake the frost off my back.
Herdmates follow me.
I lower my head for grass.
I plant my hooves in the snow.
The wind comes from the north.
I begin patrolling the snowfield.
On the snow, I breathe out white.

lines.zh: 草够吃，我的绒就会长厚。
lines.en: Enough grass and my qiviut thickens.
I wait in the snow for the wind to drop.

lines.zh: 火燎到我的长毛，我往前冲。
lines.en: Fire catches my long coat and I lunge forward.
I fell down the slope and rolled.

lines.zh: 水漫过我的背，我蹬着上岸。
lines.en: Water covers my back; I kick for shore.
The blast tips me onto my side.

lines.zh: 一支箭陷进我的厚毛，进不到皮。
lines.en: An arrow sinks into my coat, not my hide.

lines.zh: 紫色的光让我看不清雪面。
lines.en: Violet light blurs the snow.
Lightning hits my back and I shudder.
